flashcards.back: The longest side of a right-angled triangle, across from the right angle: length 5 in the 3-4-5 triangle, found as c in a² + b² = c².
The positive length whose square gives the number: the square root of 25 is 5, which turns c² = 25 back into the length c = 5.
The theorem run backwards: if the squares of the two shorter sides add to the square of the longest side, as 9 + 16 = 25 does for sides 3, 4 and 5, then the triangle must be right-angled.

Opposite and adjacent swap places under pressure. Always read TOA: tan is opposite over adjacent. For the 3-4-5 triangle that means tan theta = 3/4 = 0.75, never 4/3 - the opposite side 3 goes on top.
